description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice calling for claims to property of Intestate Moratuwa D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The notice is about establishing legal ownership and registration of land titles for deceased persons' properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
